d:
This time on Lallantop Adda, we have an exclusive one-to-one conversation with Dr. Satyajit Kumar Singh, Founder of Ruban Group of Hospitals and a renowned urologist from Patna. Dr. Singh talks about Bihar’s healthcare sector, medical facilities, challenges faced by patients, and the changing healthcare landscape. He also discusses the journey of Ruban Group and his vision for accessible and quality healthcare in Bihar.
Production: Ritu
Video Editor: Shivam Sharma
